pages.text: An ordinary Eye of Ender points to a single destination. Bathe it in dragon breath and steady its fracture with crystalline aether, and it can finally gaze into another world.

pages.title: Leave its gaze on the anchor
pages.text: Craft it after gathering dragon breath and chorus materials in the End. Use it on your personal anchor to supply its bound receiver across worlds.$(br2)No second anchor is needed at the destination, but the home anchor and supply must remain active. An ordinary Eye of Ender cannot perform this upgrade.
